summary.zh: 检查 PPT 的排版越界、可编辑性和文件完整性
summary.en: Check deck geometry, accessibility, and file integrity

description.zh: 交付前校验页面几何、文字溢出、阅读顺序、图片替代文本和来源引用，并检查 OOXML 包是否损坏。发现问题时回到规格或构建脚本修复后重跑同一套检查。适合对外发布前的最后一道关。
description.en: Validates geometry, text overflow, reading order, alt text, source references, and OOXML package integrity before delivery. Failures are repaired and rechecked. Use it as the last gate before sharing a deck.
